items.title: Frank Chace Interview, 1961-11-18
items.q: I haven't heard him very much... he's just one of many guys that I don't think is helpful in trying to discuss tendencies or influences in clarinet playing.

ctx.x: Who was the clarinetist with Ted Weems for a while, who got into Dixie working? Rosie McCard.

Yeah. Rosie, I'm sure, did a lot of record listening. His arrangements, for example, are rearrangements of Memphis Five, an original Dixieland jazz band and so forth. And have you any information about Rosie, where his influence or enthusiasm might have went?
